title: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccine
overview: HPV (human papillomavirus) vaccine can prevent infection with some types of human papillomavirus.

sections.Tell your vaccination provider if the pe: Has had an allergic reaction after a previous dose of HPV vaccine, or has any severe life-threatening allergies.Is pregnant -- HPV vaccine is not recommended until after pregnancy.In some cases, your health care provider may decide to postpone HPV vaccination until a future visit.People with minor illnesses, such as a cold, may be vaccinated. People who are moderately or severely ill should usually wait until they recover before getting HPV vaccine.Your health care provider can give you more information.
